HOME COURTYARD
The patched porch and stacked wood make this place easy to recognize from the lane. The dispatcher is taking runners inside the courier hall on the eastern street.

[E] Continue

SHARED GARDEN
Keep to the aisles around and between the timber beds. The neighbor beside the northern aisle has spare cuttings for the open bed on the right.

[E] Continue

OPEN GARDEN BED
The right bed has room for three rows. The neighbor beside the northern aisle has the shared cuttings; speak to them before planting.

[E] Continue

GARDEN NEIGHBOR
The left bed is planted. We left the right bed open for these spare cuttings. You can plant them from the southern aisle; keep your feet out of the beds.

[E] Continue

SHARED CUTTINGS
You place the spare cuttings in three spaced rows. Both timber beds are planted now, and the aisles around them are clear.

[E] Continue

SHARED CUTTINGS
Three fresh rows fill the right bed. The cuttings are still small, with open soil between them. The walking aisles remain clear.

[E] Continue

GARDEN NEIGHBOR
Those three rows are in. The new cuttings are easy to see against the open soil. Thanks for helping, and keep to the aisles while they settle.

[E] Continue
